purpose: pre-registered test of whether the rebuilt FNaF 4, given a phone night's own touches, plays that night as the phone did at some seed
claimLevel: MODEL_ONLY rebuild replays (rebuilt-runtime) of a DEVICE_MEASURED night
step: ROADMAP S6: the rebuild against the phone (FNaF 4's counterpart of S2's seed scan)
question: Given n5b's own touches, does the rebuilt FNaF 4 (pinned 57b48ac1-615f2ea0) play Night 5 as the phone did -- Fredbear landing R at 6 s, L at 9 s, R at 15 s and R at 21 s of level time, no landing on the other roll ticks to 36 s, and the black onset at level 39.25 s -- at some seed, and at exactly one?

hypothesis.statement: E-reproduce: some seed's replay matches every heard roll tick and blacks out inside the death window.
alternatives: E-mapping: no seed matches -- the rebuild, or this night's touch mapping (landing latencies borrowed from FNaF 2, the level origin, the window transform), does not play n5b as the phone did (NOT_REPRODUCED).
E-underdetermined: several seeds match (REPRODUCED_MULTIPLE): the rebuild can play the night, and these observations do not pick its seed.

run.custody: packed 2026-10-02 from artifacts/runs (the bytes the record names); the pack redacts home paths only, and the rows are byte-identical from either

phone.read: derived['n5b-replay'].hearing: stereo replay of the night's A2DP mix; accepted landings R@6s L@9s R@15s R@21s, every other side tick to 36 s silent (<= 0.137 against a 0.19 floor); timeline: all black from night 38.73 s, the level's t = 0 is 0.52 s before night 0 (LEVEL_ORIGIN_MS), so level 39.25 s = update 2355

mapping.source: docs/evidence/phone-release-latency-20261001.json (phone-release-latency-4dd971d24ad952a1): FNaF 2 on the same handset and HID transport; FNaF 4's own landing latency is not measured
mapping.levelOrigin: run.json night.epochHostMs + LEVEL_ORIGIN_MS (-520, fnaf4-run.ts), 60 updates a second
mapping.gestures: a press from its request to its release; a double's two contacts from the request to firstReleasedHostMs and from that plus gapMs to the release (night-kit Actor.double); Continue is the title's own button (window 512, 460) at update 301

save.why: its night key is 5: Continue plays Night 5 (the still runs logged Night 5, shadow 0)

drawRule.text: In an update holding a 3000 ms roll, g229's four draws come first; his direction is the fourth (Random(2), 1 = right) and the roll (g286: Random(20) + 1 <= 12) the fifth, or the eighth when the 5000 ms group's three draws share the update (update % 300 = 0). A pass lands him on that side from the centre or a side, or walks him into that side's hall (HR/HL); in the hall, closet or bed the roll is drawn and he does not move.
drawRule.developmentText: Found and checked on these 45 roll ticks (four seeds with no touch, one with n5b's rows, all on the pinned binary); none of the ticks below is part of the test.

prefixText: Under n5b's rows the draw schedule is the same on seeds 24850 and 1234 until update 600 (the 10 s group then varies by state), with two walk draws before update 180, so the first three rolls are read off the generator alone. At 3 s he is at the centre, where every pass in the development lands, so the silent tick is a failed roll.

validity.text: 20 seeds stage 1 drops, replayed too: each row records whether the seed's own trace has the prefix's draw counts (prefixOk). Any prefixOk false among them or the kept seeds voids stage 1 and the verdict is UNINFORMATIVE.

decisionRule.text: A kept seed matches when its replay's roll-tick string (L/R a fresh living-room landing that update, '-' anything else, for 3 s..36 s) equals the heard string and `gameover` turns 1 within update 2355 +- 60 (one second; the fuse's deaths fall on the 3 s roll grid, so no neighbouring roll's death is inside it). REPRODUCED_UNIQUE: exactly one seed matches. REPRODUCED_MULTIPLE: more than one. NOT_REPRODUCED: none. UNINFORMATIVE: a prefixOk false, or more than 1% of stage-2 rows errored. Seeds matching the landings alone are reported, not tested.

stoppingRule.text: Every kept seed and the 20 validity seeds, once. Nothing in the mapping, the rule or the window changes after the scan; another mapping is a new predeclaration.

command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=2500M -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p CPUWeight=10 -- nice -n 19 node packages/propose/bin/recompile/fnaf4-run-seed.ts scan --predeclaration <this file> --binary <pinned>/Chowdren --assets <pinned>/Assets.dat --out <outside the repository> --jobs 3; then decide --results <out>/results.jsonl
rung: None. REPRODUCED says the rebuild can play a phone night's encounters from its touches (a seed measurement for FNaF 4 if UNIQUE); it promotes nothing and claims nothing about the model.

stage1.text: the seeds prefilter() keeps over all 65,536 under the prefix: counted before the scan, re-counted by the gate
